## Stochastic analysis and dynamics
My main research area is stochastic dynamical systems, stochastic flows, and their interaction with geometric structures. I am interested in differential equations driven by irregular signals and rough path methods.

## Research interests
- **Rough paths and flows:** Young integration, irregular dynamics, and decompositions of flows.
- **Stochastic dynamics on Lie groups:** the interaction between geometry and stochastic processes.
- **Stochastic PDEs:** analytical questions for systems subject to random perturbations.
- **Lévy processes and stochastic control:** dynamics with jumps and optimization problems.
- **Topology and relations:** topological constructions induced by group actions and binary relations.

## Work in progress
These topics concern work in preparation. Manuscripts will be added when they are ready for public circulation.

### Rough paths and Navier–Stokes
Fluid equations under irregular perturbations, with an emphasis on projected transport and the analytical structure of the equations.

### Markov topology
Work on topological structures associated with relations and Markov-type constructions.

### Goldbach and Alexandroff spaces
Relational constructions and Alexandroff spaces associated with Goldbach representations.
